opportunities.name: Ryanair round-trip flight search
opportunities.description: On Ryanair, search a return flight by entering origin, destination, depart and return dates, and passenger count, then select outbound and return flights.
steps: Enter origin airport in From field
Open To field, choose destination country then airport
Set passengers via Adults stepper and click Done

instances.values: Dublin->Athens, 2 Apr-5 Apr, 1 adult, selected both flights
Tel Aviv->Venice Treviso, 9 May-16 May, 1 adult, selected both flights
Dublin->Paris Beauvais, 26 Apr-2 May, 2 adults, promo code attempt

opportunities.name: Booking.com attraction search by destination and date
opportunities.description: On Booking.com Attractions, search a destination and date, then open a result and view availability/tickets.
steps: Type destination in search box and select suggestion
Open date picker and choose date
Open an attraction result and click See availability
Choose ticket quantities and click Next

instances.values: Kyoto, 25 May, filters (free cancellation, Tours), sorted Most popular, Fushimi Inari tour, 2 adults 1 infant

opportunities.name: Resy restaurant search and availability/notify
opportunities.description: On Resy, set city, search for a restaurant or cuisine, then check availability by date/guests and set a Notify.
steps: Optionally change city via city selector

Click Notify for a meal slot and confirm time window
